caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object shown from two perspectives: a top-down view and a side profile view. The object is rendered in shades of brown with darker and lighter areas indicating texture and shading. In the top-down view, the object has a large, irregular, rounded shape resembling a leaf with visible veins, and features a circular, ribbed central element. This central circle is surrounded by a scalloped border, and a handle extends to the right, decorated with curving, carved-like details. In the side view beneath, the object’s handle appears ribbed and undulating, and a raised, cylindrical holder is centrally positioned on the leaf-like surface. The drawing is signed "Florence Stevenson" in the bottom right corner, and a small linear scale is present in the bottom left. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Candle Socket
